scheduler.paper_ambiguity: Paper also says cosine annealing; use explicit every20epochs half

architecture.group_choice: Fig.1 and TableII agree on6x4; one text sentence swaps6and4
architecture.internal_projection: 64 outer channels, 32-channel wavelet bottleneck; 1x1 entry and group refinement. Inferred missing dimensions, not author-confirmed
architecture.parameter_constraint: Bottleneck interpretation approximately0.964M atx4, near reported0.977M; closeness is a consistency check, not proof of original implementation
architecture.ss2d: Author SS2D, d_state16, expand2; expansion not stated in paper
architecture.hfem: Fig3 order: linear+DWConv low and high branches, sigmoid high gate, then PDC; Eq14 places PDC differently
architecture.pdc: Shared across three high-frequency subbands; depthwise branches follow four differential branches of author code
architecture.subband_fusion: Concatenate LL/HL/LH/HH for valid IDWT dimensions; grouped1x1 refinement preserves four subbands
architecture.normalization: Post-IDWT LayerNorm retained from public WAM to reconcile omitted detail
architecture.parameter_count: Measured independently; paper977K cannot be guaranteed from incomplete dimensions

evaluation.image: clamp0..255 then BT601 Y; per-image PSNR/SSIM averaged; no biased rounding
evaluation.physical: unclipped mean of3channels inverse fixed -2..40C normalization
evaluation.checkpoint: fixed final epoch; no test-based model selection
